meta.notes:
## Weibo recipe notes

Re-checked 2026-11-13: `m.weibo.cn` (iPhone UA 390x844, logged out, headless Chromium, non-China IP) redirected through visitor.passport.weibo.cn and loaded the Vue feed with no captcha. Home feed only; the search and post pages were not re-opened this round (their rules keep the 2026-11-08 evidence).

## LIVE on the home feed (15 posts)

- `.weibo-top > .m-avatar-box` 15, `.weibo-top .m-avatar-box img` 15, `.weibo-top .m-avatar-box i.m-icon` 15 (goldv / orangev badge classes)
- `.weibo-top h3 img.vipicon` 15 (member icon); `.weibo-top h4 > .time` 15, `.weibo-top h4 > .from` 12 (some posts lack a client name)
- `.weibo-rp` 2 (quoted original inside a repost; both carry their own media)
- `.weibo-media img` 29 (picture and video cover images), `.mwb-video .mwbv-info-bar` 8 (plays and duration)
- `.nav-top .nav-search .m-text-cut` 1 (search-bar hint text; the search link itself is kept)
- Unchanged from before: `div.login-box:has(> a.login-btn)` 1; `.m-followBtn` 0 on the Hot tab (20 on Charts earlier); `footer.f-footer-ctrl > div.m-diy-btn` 45; `.nav-main` 1.

## Notes

- `.weibo-media` also matches the inner wrap, so the hide-media rule is not touched; the new blur rules target the images only.
- Source: weibo.cn / weibo.com nuisance reports in uBlockOrigin/uAssets (#23990 app-install popup, #23851 login popup on video) describe script-driven popups that CSS cannot stop; no cosmetic list rule exists for these classes.

## Not verified

- Logged-in feeds, desktop weibo.com, the "Follow" button count on Hot, the hint text on other pages.
- Badges and the avatar column rules on the post page (fixture only).
